changes.note: wslServers: 11-method Rust subsystem, Windows-only, degrades gracefully. NOT a wiring gap. Deferrable.
Micro-PR: skill tool publishes session.skill.activated (SessionV2.skill() already does at session.ts:635). Gives change-008 a durable loaded-skill ledger.
changes.dropped_reason: DROPPED after verification. Publishing session.skill.activated from the skill TOOL would DOUBLE-INJECT skill content: to-llm-message.ts maps a `skill` message to a user message carrying skill.content, but the tool already injects that same content via its <skill_content> output. And it is UNNECESSARY: change-008 can track loaded skills via the existing ctx.tool.hook('execute.after') (carries tool name, sessionID, and input.id) with ZERO core change. Loaded-skill tracking moves into change-008.

decisions.governing_constraint: Zero permanent core divergence. Core changes must be shaped as upstreamable contributions, not private patches.
decisions.abandoned: The 19-file patch-port onto packages/opencode. That tree is V1 reference-only per AGENTS.md:4 — it applied cleanly because nothing touches it.
decisions.ranking_strategy: Contribute the missing hook upstream, then build ranking as a pure plugin on top of it.
dropped: skills object config (v2 skills key is string[])
